title: A fault that slides the opposite way
text: Unlike most other faults in California, the Garlock Fault slips left-laterally. It is believed to have developed to take up the strain between the stretching crust of the Great Basin and the faulting of the Mojave Desert crust. Geologists have described it as a fault that accommodates stretching in the Basin and Range country to the north, relative to the steadier Mojave block to the south.

s2.title: Garlock Fault
s2.quote: Unlike most of the other faults in California, slip on the Garlock Fault is left-lateral ... believed to have developed to accommodate the strain between the extensional tectonics of the Great Basin crust and the right lateral strike-slip faulting of the Mojave Desert crust.
